text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "...Again, not again. I lost again..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Why do I keep losing like this? I'm giving 
it everything I've got, too...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Is giving it my all just not enough? I... 
I—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —Ugh... ugh... uuuugh~~...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I... I'm sure... I'm already... no good 
anymore..."
choice_data_list:
So should I just stay the way I am, no 
good as I am?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Wh-Why...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Because even though I've already lost so 
many times...!"
choice_data_list:
Still, I believe you'll definitely win 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaaaaaaahhhhhh!!!!!!
(SMACKKK!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Owww-w-w-wwch...!! I-I slapped myself way 
too hard...!
choice_data_list: W-What the heck are you doing!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, Trainer...! This is how it 
should be!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even though you believe in me, Trainer...! 
I can't just sit here moping around!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Still, that just now let me say goodbye to 
it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll live up to your feelings, Trainer! 
Next time—I won't lose ever again!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Again and again... as many times as it 
takes!! I'll clash against you with all my 
might---!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: N-NO WAY!! I hate that so muuuuch!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Because I haven't moved everyone's hearts 
yet!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So... that's why! I don't wanna stay a 
failure forever!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! What can I do... so I won't 
be such a failure anymore?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That's right! There's no other 
way!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll do my best. And the next 
time I cry, it'll be—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm happy when I win, that's 
whyyyy!!
